name: Rhetan TMT Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, Rhetan TMT Ltd is in the business of Manufacturing of TMT Bars[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
RTMTL (Formerly known as Rhetan Rolling Mills Private Limited) is in the business of manufacturing premium Quality TMT Bars confirming to ISI Standards

cons: Stock is trading at 18.7 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 5.32% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.6.56 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 224 days.
Working capital days have increased from 477 days to 718 days
